mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona City Hall with a comfortable temperature of 68 degrees.

The City of Verona is highlighting two important updates today. First, you can help protect our local rivers and lakes by volunteering for the Adopt a Storm Drain program through the Dane County Ripple Effects website. Additionally, road reconstruction is ongoing on Mark Drive, with Phase 2 currently underway including utility and roadway improvements.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at trivia nights at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's, with more music and community events continuing throughout the week.

Regarding the police department report, on October 15, officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I following reports of dangerous driving. The investigation is ongoing, and police are asking anyone with information to come forward.
Today's flavor of the day is a delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Culver's is open until 10:00 PM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a treat before they close for the night.
